videos.title: I Built My Own Task Manager In Claude Code (It's Free!)
videos.summary: I built a custom task manager using Claude Code to monitor CPU and memory usage on Linux and Windows systems. It's free and opensource available on GitHub.

videos.title: I Fixed My Android TV With Claude Code + CleanYourTV
videos.summary: Clean your Android TV home screen by removing unwanted bloatware and ads using the CleanYourTV available as a free GitHub repository. Enjoy watching and please subscribe!

videos.title: I Tested This FREE Claude Design Alternative (It's Good!)
videos.summary: Mike installs Open Design, a free Claude Design alternative, on Linux from source, fixes its Node and Corepack setup, connects a model with an API key, then uses it to make a motion design clip, a visual design system and an HTML slide deck from a YouTube link. The last chapter covers its pricing and credit use.

videos.title: I Built a Virtual Office for My AI Agents in GrokBot
videos.summary: In this video, I build a 2D Virtual Office for 35+ AI agents running inside GrokBot using the new Pages feature!

videos.title: I Let GrokBot Run My Blog for 30 Days (Here's What Happened)
videos.summary: Connect GrokBot to WordPress with its plugin, then let an agent turn YouTube transcripts into scheduled blog posts that also go out to email subscribers. The recording hits GrokBot's weekly usage limit, so most of the demo reviews posts that were already drafted and scheduled.

videos.title: Herdr Lets You Run Claude Code And Codex In One Place
videos.summary: Install Herdr and run Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and Hermes from one terminal workspace that saves every session. Covers installing on Mac, Linux and Windows, then a hands-on review.

videos.title: I Let Runable Build My Entire Online Business!
videos.summary: Research, build and refine an AI Growth Audit website in Runable. Covers the project brief, market research and homepage revisions; Stripe and email delivery remain unfinished.
